verdict.rationale: Productboard says it can push prioritized features into delivery and "track their status", and Spark can check Linear project progress. That is a thin, first-party form of status tracking for in-progress work. Webhooks offer real-time change notifications, but they are a developer building block, not a status view a PM can watch, so they earn no credit. missing for 10: real-time per-task status view, blocker/blocked-on visibility, last-update timestamps, detailed documentation of the status-tracking feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can watch the real-time status of each in-progress task, including what it's blocked on and its last update

citations.quote: Push prioritized features into delivery, track their status, and sync key data.
